title: Petri net input (JSON)
description: Canonical JSON form of a Petri net S = (P, T, I, O, mu0) with optional v2 extension fields (inhibitor arcs, transition priorities, output-arc delays, colored layer), the single intake model shared by all three channels (raw text, JSON, form; ADR-0003). Validation is two-pass: this schema (pass 1) checks structure only. Pass 2, run by the same validator and reported in the same 422 error format, enforces the cross-field rules JSON Schema cannot express: initial_marking keys must be exactly the declared places, inputs/outputs keys (and their inner keys) must be declared transitions (and places), inhibitors/priorities/delays keys must be declared transitions (and their places declared), delay pairs must be existing output arcs, and colors keys must be declared places (initial_values) or declared transitions (guards, output_exprs).

places.description: Declared place names P, in order (unique identifier strings).

transitions.description: Declared transition names T, in order (unique identifier strings).

inputs.description: Input arcs I: transition -> (place -> positive integer weight). Optional key — absent = empty map (all input weights 0). Pass 2 enforces that every key is a declared transition and every inner key a declared place.

outputs.description: Output arcs O: transition -> (place -> positive integer weight). Optional key — absent = empty map (all output weights 0). Pass 2 enforces that every key is a declared transition and every inner key a declared place.

initial_marking.description: Initial marking mu0: place -> non-negative integer token count. Pass 2 enforces that the keys are exactly the declared places: a missing place is a validation error (not an implicit 0) and surplus keys are errors too.

inhibitors.description: Inhibitor arcs ⊣ (v2): transition -> list of distinct declared places. Optional key — absent = no inhibitor arcs (classical net); the inhibitor weight is always 1. Pass 2 enforces that every key is a declared transition and every list element a declared place.

priorities.description: Transition priorities Pr t (v2): transition -> non-negative integer. Optional key — absent = no priorities (classical net); a declared transition missing from the map gets priority 0. Pass 2 enforces that every key is a declared transition.

delays.description: Output-arc delays τ (v2): transition -> (place -> τ, τ ≥ 1). Optional key — absent = no delays (classical net). Pass 2 enforces that every key is a declared transition, every inner key a declared place, and the pair an existing output arc t -> p.

colors.description: Colored layer (v2, A-21): data only, no semantics. Optional key — absent = classical net. Sub-keys are optional (absent = empty map). Pass 2 enforces that initial_values keys are declared places and guards/output_exprs keys declared transitions.

initial_values.description: place -> list of initial color values (string expressions).

guards.description: transition -> list of guard expressions of its input arcs (non-empty strings).

output_exprs.description: transition -> list of value expressions of the tokens it places (non-empty strings).
